title: Machine-readable architecture decision records with human review receipts
author: ArchPulse architecture proposal

alternatives.label: Markdown-only ADRs
alternatives.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  Author["Author narrative ADR"] --> Human["Human reviews text"]
  Human --> History["Git history"]

alternatives.label: JSON receipt plus Markdown narrative
alternatives.tradeoffs: Offline validation with extra maintenance and human review
alternatives.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  Source["S22 and task"] --> Json["Versioned JSON record"]
  Json --> Check["Offline validator / CI"]
  Json --> Markdown["Mermaid + rationale"]
  Check --> Review["Human review gate"]

proposal: Explore a JSON-backed ADR lifecycle while preserving Markdown narratives; no accepted decision yet.

migration.forward: Introduce optional JSON records for proposals, then require a reviewed record before Accepted.
migration.rollback: Revert validation changes without deleting original ADR history.
migration.compatibility: Markdown-only proposed ADRs remain proposals; no automatic adoption.

verification.graphImpact: Decision metadata only; runtime evidence graph is not implemented.
